title: This Windows PC (Windows PowerShell and built-in tools, run as the signed-in user, no administrator)

checks.title: BitLocker protects the system drive
checks.scope: Get-BitLockerVolume on the system drive: VolumeStatus FullyEncrypted and ProtectionStatus On. Needs an administrator (Win32_EncryptableVolume); a standard user's run is skipped. Other drives and the module's FIPS validation are not shown.

checks.title: Windows installed updates within --windows-update-days days
checks.scope: Windows Update Agent's LastInstallationSuccessDate and the newest Get-HotFix InstalledOn must both be recent. The first counts any update, Defender definitions included; the second lists only Component Based Servicing packages, by Microsoft's own description. Updates offered but not yet installed are not listed.

checks.title: No policy or service setting turns automatic Windows updates off
checks.scope: Policy NoAutoUpdate is not 1 and AUOptions is not 1 or 2 (HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU), the wuauserv service is not Disabled, and Automatic Updates reports ServiceEnabled. A pause chosen in Settings is not read.

checks.title: The Windows build is at least --windows-min-build (a version Microsoft still updates)
checks.scope: Win32_OperatingSystem BuildNumber against the option, or by default against the Home and Pro end-of-updates dates of Windows 11 release information (read 2026-10-26) on the run date: 25H2 (26200) until 2027-10-12, 26H1 (28000) until 2028-03-14, 26H2 (26300) until 2028-10-10, so the floor rises to 26300 on 2027-10-13. Windows 10 Extended Security Updates enrolment is not readable.

checks.title: Microsoft Defender Antivirus is active with real-time protection on
checks.scope: Get-MpComputerStatus: AMRunningMode Normal, AMServiceEnabled, AntivirusEnabled and RealTimeProtectionEnabled. A third-party antivirus registered in Windows Security Center is named and skipped, for a person to confirm. Alerting on detection is not shown.

checks.title: Defender's antivirus definitions were updated within --windows-signature-days days
checks.scope: Get-MpComputerStatus AntivirusSignatureLastUpdated (or AntivirusSignatureAge); skipped when another antivirus is the active one.

checks.title: Windows Firewall is on for the Domain, Private and Public profiles
checks.scope: Get-NetFirewallProfile -PolicyStore ActiveStore (local settings and Group Policy combined); its rules are not judged. A network firewall in front of the PC is not shown.

checks.title: Windows locks within --windows-max-lock-seconds seconds of inactivity
checks.scope: The machine inactivity limit (InactivityTimeoutSecs), or a password-protected screen saver (ScreenSaveActive, ScreenSaverIsSecure, ScreenSaveTimeOut; policy values first, then the user's). Sign-in on wake after the display turns off or the PC sleeps, and Dynamic Lock, are not read.

checks.title: Automatic sign-in is off
checks.scope: Winlogon AutoAdminLogon is not 1. The user name and password values beside it are never read.

checks.title: The signed-in account is not a local administrator
checks.scope: whoami /groups: the token of the account running the collector holds no S-1-5-32-544 (Administrators), elevated or not; the group's member count is reported. Other accounts on the PC are not judged, and no name is read.

checks.title: Secure Boot is on
checks.scope: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI. Needs an administrator; a standard user's run is skipped. A BIOS (legacy) PC fails.
